name: Empornium
description: Empornium (EMP) is a Private Torrent Tracker for 3X.

levelRequirements.name: Apprentice
levelRequirements.privilege: The default class of new members.

levelRequirements.name: Perv
levelRequirements.privilege: can access top10 lists;  can add and vote on tags;  can use upload templates;  can set forum signature (up to 128 characters)

levelRequirements.name: Good Perv
levelRequirements.privilege: can access site statistics;  can create public upload templates;  can create and vote in requests;  can use the notifications system;  can create collages;  can create up to 2 personal collages;  can add multiple tags at once;  can see uploaders name in upload (unless forced hidden);  can download zips of torrent files (from collages, and user pages);  can play Slot Machine;  can create polls in the forums;  can bump threads in the forums;  can set forum signature (up to 256 characters)

levelRequirements.name: Better Perv
levelRequirements.privilege: can see staff list on Staff page; can send invites (if you have any); can create an additional personal collage (3 total); can set forum signature (up to 512 characters)

levelRequirements.name: Great Perv
levelRequirements.privilege: can see staff list on Staff page;  can access the Invite forum;  can send invites (if you have any);  can create an additional personal collage (3 total);  can set forum signature (up to 512 characters)

levelRequirements.name: Sextreme Perv
levelRequirements.privilege: can see staff list on Staff page; can create 2 additional personal collages (5 total); can set forum signature (up to 1024 characters)

levelRequirements.name: Smut Peddler
levelRequirements.privilege: can create 5 additional personal collages (10 total); can set forum signature (up to 2048 characters)
